instruction: Launch GIMP from the command line to edit "cola.png" and crop the top 20% off the image for my avatar as "cropped.png".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires cropping top 20% of cola.png (1233x1280). Expected result: 1233x1024. Verified: 1280 * 0.8 = 1024 pixels height.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts dimensions from the output file (cropped.png) using PIL Image.open()
Metric correctly compares both width and height with appropriate 2-pixel tolerance for rounding
Expected values are semantically correct: width=1233 (unchanged), height=1024 (1280 * 0.8 = removing top 20%)
Complete coverage: dimension check is sufficient to verify top 20% was cropped, as this produces unique dimensions
Proper error handling: getter returns None for missing files, metric returns 0.0 for None results
Logical data flow is correct: download file from VM → extract dimensions → compare with expected
The evaluator can successfully verify whether the instruction was completed correctly
